answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. Written in a analytical prose structured with explicit logical operators and causality register, it stays short. A spiral of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pulse of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The zephyr of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
